limitations: Predictions describe observed-report onset (first monitored report), not confirmed biological outbreak onset.
Negative labels are naive/coarse absence (no report), not confirmed ecological absence; reporting/survey-effort bias is not corrected for.

The underlying event is rare and severely class-imbalanced; the model was trained with class-weighting to address this, which is why its output is a score, not a calibrated probability (see calibration_assessment.json).

Several clients (e.g. Uganda, Afghanistan) have zero or very few positive training examples; predictions for these clients rely on federated/pooled signal from other clients, not client-specific history.
The federated learning system is a research simulation (Flower, single-machine), not a live multi-institution deployment.
Risk-tier thresholds (LOW/MODERATE/HIGH) are configurable decision-support settings, not biologically validated thresholds.
